description: Auto-model routing strategy (chat-studio §8.5, COMP-05). Task/context signals map to required capabilities; models are scored on tier preference. Empty candidate list = configuration error surfaced to UI, never a silent bad pick.

messages.visionRequired: attachments include an image; picked a vision-capable model
messages.pdfRequired: attachments include a PDF; picked a model that accepts PDF input
messages.toolsRequired: tools are enabled for this turn; picked a tool-capable model
messages.longContextRequired: long input approaches the model context limit; picked a larger-context model
messages.generalChat: no special requirements; picked general chat model
messages.fallbackTier: no exact tier match; used {tier} fallback
messages.noCandidates: no enabled Profile/model satisfies the required capabilities — configure a Profile with a model that supports: {requirements}
messages.preferredUnavailable: assistant preferred model unavailable ({profile}/{model}); fell back to Auto
